caption: The timeline shows log volume over days: 90 days active at 900 GB, archive at 275 GB from day 90 to day 365, then a purge window from day 365 to day 395. Notice that the archive bar is compressed, not raw. The purge bar applies to the log set written up to day 365; no new logs are counted in the zero-after-purge figure.

spec.aria: A retention timeline for logs: 90 days active at 900 GB, archive from day 90 to day 365 at 275 GB, then a purge window from day 365 to day 395. The purge applies to logs written up to day 365; no new logs are counted.
